tool_input.message:
All 8 review findings fixed in docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex, committed as 78cdcee on feat/z-spec-state-machines. make check is green; fuzz reports 0 errors; pdflatex -halt-on-error exits 0 (verified two passes, no undefined references, no "??" in the rendered PDF text).

Item 1 (substantive, dead rootGlob clause): confirmed the bug exactly as described — ENTRY's own invariant makes rootGlob=ztrue imply truncLen=0, so the old `truncLen_i>0 ∧ truncLen_j>0 ∧ (rootGlob_i ∨ rootGlob_j ∨ ...)` conjunction could never fire via the rootGlob branch. Replaced both Store's invariant and AdmitMission's guard with pathsOverlap's own "empty-and-not-root matches nothing" exclusion, matching conflict.go:266-270. Re-verified with fresh ProB runs: isolated Init/AdmitMission/ReleaseMission now certifies complete at 5790 states/28535 transitions (down from 7266/35915, since the corrected invariant now properly excludes root-glob-vs-anything states that were wrongly permitted before); the whole committed file reaches the identical 5790-state count at 34324 transitions, uncertified but stable across a 5x larger operation budget.

Items 2-3 (build): moved \implies/\comp out of \field{} text mode into real math mode at all 4 sites; replaced the cross-file \S\ref to spec-mission-lifecycle.tex's labels (which only ever rendered "??") with literal subsection names. pdflatex now compiles clean.

Item 4 (prose): corrected — lint.go:193's HasSuffix guard tests the raw entry string, not CanonicalPath's joined string; only the HasPrefix half (reached only if the guard passes) uses CanonicalPath.

Item 5 (model): added pathContainedBy's own empty-list refusal (conflict.go:363-365) as a leading conjunct to both PathContainedByBuggy and PathContainedByFixed.

Item 6 (record/arithmetic): rebuilt the isolated scratch model exactly as specified and re-ran everything post-fix (numbers above). While reconciling I also discovered the vaib-buggy deadlock-search counts are not stable across repeated invocations at a fixed setsize — a deadlock search halts at the first violation found, and which one gets visited first varies run to run (observed 1-4 states / 5-8 transitions across 8+ repeated runs at setsize 2 and 3). I reworded that section and the tool-run table to report the observed range and state plainly that only the deadlock's existence is a robust claim, rather than asserting a specific reproducible count that isn't actually reproducible. The 8ady-buggy pairing, by contrast, was stable at 1/5 across every run I tried.

Item 7 (citations): root-glob quote conflict.go:303-305 → 254-255; audited-delegation.md example 339-340 → 338; added the missing ws-dir×ei-dir leg to the six-rule dispatch walk-through; conflict.go:360-378 → 360-379 (carried over from last round, still correct).

Item 8 (wording): "Three separate probcli runs" → "three demonstrations," with the six tabulated runs called out explicitly as the buggy/fixed pairings per demonstration plus the admission model checked twice.

Final tool-run numbers, all from fresh re-runs this round: committed file as a whole 5790 states/34324 transitions (0 violations, not certified complete); isolated admission model 5790/28535 (certified complete, 0 violations); ethos-vaib buggy 1-4 states/5-8 transitions across repeated runs (deadlock every time); ethos-vaib fixed 5/9 (clean, stable); ethos-8ady buggy 1/5 (deadlock, stable); ethos-8ady fixed 5/9 (clean, stable).
